files_changed.changes: Added target-only actual-stream credit regressions for both cache-control retry rungs, with server-tool refusal and text-only recovery controls. Retained existing cache, TTL, no-cache, extension-prefix, and server-cleared-boundary cases.

Honors the catalog-specific selected root. Uses the actual target native-compaction builder instead of fabricating the legacy envelope; asserts native classification and unchanged ordinary baseline after both equal and changed native requests. Uses the documented warmer action on 18.7/18.10.

Admits 18.10.0. Separates legacy source-less committed omissions, server-managed reports, and explicit client-prefix-binding repairs. Checks server reports preserve signed/redacted wire blocks live and after fresh-state resume; legacy omissions and client repairs remain durable. Retains endpoint/model isolation and malformed-record cases.

Admits target whole-chain and signed-native behavior, removes the target fixture's legacy encrypted payload field, and adds fail-closed default transport. Removes incidental instruction/log wording checks while preserving message, signature, boundary, fallback-reason, and warning observables.
Admits 18.10.0, removes an unused root and obsolete source-wiring coverage claims. Existing behavioral serializer checks remain.

Admits 18.10.0 throughout existing recovery, capacity, metadata, and declaration-consumer legs. Adds actual compact() effective-lane terminal refusal, actual loopback entitlement rejection with no SSE/V1/local fallback, and an independent ordinary-turn entitlement recovery control. Removes maintenance source-text assertions. Blocks uninjected HTTP.
Admits 18.10.0, exercises a low initial target effort header and persisted required sessionId, and retains actual serialized resume/branch/history cases. Blocks uninjected HTTP.

Admits target live-chain behavior and blocks default network transport. Removes host import/callsite-count/source-wiring assertions and incidental merged-heading assertions; keeps behavioral request/prefix/summary-presence checks.

Removed stale instructional comments and incidental log/error/summary-heading wording assertions. Retained actual request coverage, prefix identity, simulated cache behavior, named fallback reasons, and existing tiny-target/multi-window overflow regressions.
Admits 18.10.0 in all relevant trace legs, uses signed-only target native fixtures, and blocks uninjected network transport.

changes.behavior: Extended the existing explicit-prefix-binding 400 case: request A retries without its rejected thinking keys, the accepted retry actually serves fallback B, then JSON-round-tripped history with fresh provider state must omit those keys on the first resumed A request. Added controls proving request B cannot inherit A's repair and a source-less legacy record still rejects a mismatched carrier model. Older-release behavior remains applicable.

Added the target-only buffered, idless codex_previous_response_stale case beside previous_response_not_found. Both one-shot stale cases require exactly one generate:false recovery between rejected and accepted compactions; the accepted compaction must use the newly acknowledged response ID. HTTP/SSE/V1 escape count remains zero.

Added actual streamOpenAIResponses proof for upstream 0017 adoption: ordinary native history replays its opaque reasoning on the initial request; connection-bound history withholds it initially and replays it after an accepted completion. Each variant uses its own fresh public state map, real intercepted SSE consumption, and statefulResponses:false so assertions inspect full wire input rather than private helpers or delta artifacts. Removed two unused prose-matching constants.

[INFERENCE] Before the F2 source repair, buffered codex_previous_response_stale terminates instead of recovering; the added alias case should fail there while the existing previous_response_not_found control continues to recover.

[INFERENCE] The target's upstream 0017 implementation should pass both native-history variants without a product patch. An always-cold initialization fails the ordinary first request; an always-warm initialization fails the connection-bound first request.

reports.status: Repaired all three reported gate failures. No gate reruns, tests, builds, lint, or formatters executed.

repairs.cause: The ordinary stream and buffered compaction collector use different entitlement-recovery paths. Ordinary #tryDropRejectedAccessPrograms reopens the healthy WebSocket after stripping access_programs; the fixture incorrectly expected its unused SSE responder's text.
repairs.repair: Removed the mock-echo SSE expectation and responder. Assert exactly two ordinary WS attempts after seeding: entitled chained request, then entitlement-free full replay on the same healthy socket. HTTP interception now throws and its counter must stay zero. Compaction still requires typed terminal refusal, one chained attempt, zero HTTP/SSE/V1, zero soft fallback, and no committed refused metadata.
repairs.expected_change: [INFERENCE] The ordinary control succeeds through its actual WebSocket recovery instead of failing on 'ok' versus 'recovered'.

repairs.cause: The supposed successful retry contained no content blocks, so the public stream's separate benign-empty-completion policy generated additional requests.
repairs.repair: Added a valid text block start/delta/stop to the accepted SSE response. Did not disable retries or relax attempt counts, credit stripping, TTL-rung assertions, or the server-tool no-replay boundary.
repairs.expected_change: [INFERENCE] Each safe-text rung makes exactly two attempts rather than four; each server-tool credit case still stops after one.
